experiment_data.hypothesis: PPL-based distortion profiling (Qwen2.5-7B, fast mode): 用 PPL 增量替代 MSE 作为 distortion metric, 验证 PPL-guided MCKP 在 4x 压缩下能否优于 uniform 4-bit. Fast mode 只 profile budget-relevant actions (quant@4bit, evict@1/4).
experiment_data.notes: NEGATIVE: PPL-based distortion 仍无法让 Full MCKP 优于 uniform 4-bit。Full MCKP=28.07, Quant-only=15.45, Uniform 4-bit=15.45。Full MCKP 选了 47/112 heads evict，eviction 在 4x 压缩下仍然伤害 PPL（比 uniform 差 12.63）。Quant-only MCKP = Uniform 4-bit（符合预期：4x budget 下所有 head 选 4-bit 是唯一方案）。问题不在 distortion metric，而在 eviction@25% retention 本身在 4x 压缩下伤害过大。
